Comments survive a round trip, and the parser is much harder to trip up.

## Comments
With `ParseComments`, parsing and generating a document now keeps every comment in place (#43):
- trailing `// …` on a node's line;
- comments at the end of a block or of the document;
- comments between arguments;
- comments after a closing `}`;
- multi-line `/* */` comments, with their indentation;
- slash-dashed (`/-`) nodes, arguments, properties and child blocks, kept verbatim.

Generation is stable: a second parse-and-generate gives identical output.

New fields hold the extra positions:
- `Comment.Trailing`, `Comment.BeforeBlock`, `Comment.Inside` and `Comment.Closing`;
- `Value.Comment`;
- `Document.Comment`.

## Fixes
- **Hang on huge exponents (#45):** a 13-byte document such as `n 1e-10210200` made parsing or generating run for minutes. Numbers far outside the float64 range now parse and print in well under a millisecond, and round-trip exactly. Overflow becomes `#inf`, and underflow becomes `0.0`.
- **Values dropped at end of input (#44):** a document ending in `0` or `?` silently lost that value, and a trailing lone `/` was ignored.
- **Invalid KDL that was accepted (#44):**
  - an unclosed `{` when the file has no trailing newline;
  - a `/-` at end of input;
  - two child blocks on one node, whose children were merged;
  - arguments after a node's child block;
  - text after a `\` line continuation.
- **Valid KDL that was rejected (#44):**
  - a `/* */` comment as the only separator, as in `a/*c*/1` or `a k=1/*c*/2`;
  - in v2, a slash-dashed child block before the real one (`a /-{ x } { y }`);
  - in v1, a `//` comment glued to a node name.

## Testing
- 55 comment-form cases run in both KDL versions, checking that the document is the same with `ParseComments` on and off.
- Three new fuzz targets:
  - comment round trip;
  - comment-mode agreement;
  - with earlier targets, all five ran clean for millions of inputs.

## Note
Each parsed value carries one more field, so parsing allocates about 10% more memory, even with comments off.

Full details: https://github.com/njreid/gokdl2/compare/v0.7.1...v0.7.2
